answer: Proof-of-space seats stop sybils with disk instead of money. First, each identity plots a 100 GiB file, seeded from its key, which takes about 9 hours on one NVMe drive. Second, every epoch the network asks for random slices, like a yarrow stalk pulled from a bundle, and demands them within 3 seconds. Third, one drive earns one seat, and two missed challenges drop it. Forging 10,000 seats needs 1 PB, about $20,000 in drives, plus 90,000 plotting hours. Picture a hollow warehouse with painted labels: faking a full one works only until inspectors weigh a quartz crate.
